technical.summary: AVGO shows solid bullish structure with trending ADX and price above all key moving averages, but lacks fresh momentum confirmation; stochastic overbought and absence of crossover signals suggest caution on new entries despite overall uptrend alignment.

fundamental.summary: No insider buying, no institutional signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 34 days create a weak fundamental setup with elevated event risk.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; mixed market sentiment (bearish 36.7% vs bullish 28.4%) with neutral fear/greed reading; insufficient data for directional conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (180.8) indicates extreme market stress, and earnings in 34 days presents binary event risk; only DXY tailwind provides minor offset.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong technical structure with ADX trending, price above key MAs, and multiple bullish indicators (Hull flip, Ichimoku, SuperTrend, PSAR) provide solid uptrend alignment for continuation trades.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro environment is severely hostile (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels), earnings binary event in 34 days, zero fundamental conviction, stochastic overbought without fresh momentum confirmation, and price near resistance with below-average volume create unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical structure is bullish with ADX trending and price above key MAs, but macro environment is severely hostile with inverted yield curve and VIX crisis levels creating unacceptable risk/reward for new swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings binary event in 34 days combined with macro recession signals (inverted yield curve, VIX 180.8) and stochastic overbought without fresh momentum confirmation create asymmetric downside risk.
decision.recommended_exit: N/A — skip entry; if existing position held, use ATR trail 1x to protect against macro deterioration.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case; technical bullishness overridden by macro severity and fundamental weakness.
